questions.q: What framework organizes the Setup and Maintenance work area into functional areas, task lists, and tasks?
options: Functional Setup Manager (FSM)
Oracle Cloud Success Navigator
Requirements Traceability Matrix
Oracle True Cloud Method
questions.explain: Functional Setup Manager (FSM) organizes Setup and Maintenance into functional areas, task lists, and individual tasks.

options: A document listing project risks and issues
The same thing as the configuration workbook
A scoped container of task lists relevant to this specific implementation or phase
A type of Service Request
questions.explain: An Implementation Project scopes only the functional areas and task lists relevant to the current implementation, rather than exposing Oracle's entire task catalog.

questions.q: What does FSM track automatically as tasks inside an Implementation Project are marked done?
options: Defect severity levels
A completion percentage
Bank account routing numbers
Service Request response times
questions.explain: FSM tracks a completion percentage for an Implementation Project as its tasks are completed, giving the Project Manager real-time visibility.

questions.q: Why does scoping an Implementation Project tightly matter?
options: Because Oracle charges extra for unscoped task lists
Because scoping is required before fit-gap analysis can begin
Because unscoped projects cannot be opened
Because it keeps consultants focused on only the task lists relevant to their module, not Oracle's entire catalog
questions.explain: Oracle's full task catalog spans every module Oracle offers; scoping keeps a consultant focused on just what's relevant to their implementation.

questions.q: What was Brightfield's Implementation Project named and scoped to?
options: "Brightfield Phase 2 — Supply Chain," scoped to procurement only
"Brightfield Phase 1 — Financials," scoped to GL, AP, AR, and Cash Management
"Brightfield Global Rollout," scoped to all countries and modules
No Implementation Project was created
questions.explain: Brightfield's partner created "Brightfield Phase 1 — Financials," scoped to the GL, AP, AR, and Cash Management functional areas matching the Phase 1 scope statement.
